question: Sabha and Ur, two kinds of village assemblies are referred to in which of the following dynasties?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chola.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sabha:-**

 
 
• It​ was an **assembly of elders** who made **decisions for the village**, while **Ur **was an assembly of common people who **discussed and debated various issues.**
 
 
 
• **Chola dynasty:-**
 
 
• It was known for its **administrative and political prowess**, and the** existence of these assemblies** is a testament to their commitment to **democratic principles.**
 
 
 
• Sabha and Ur were two types of village assemblies that were referred to during the Chola dynasty.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Rashtrakuta dynasty:-

 
 
• It​ was known for its military conquests and architectural achievements, and there is no mention of village assemblies in their history.
 
 
 
• Gurjara Pratihara dynasty:-
 
 
• It​ was a powerful kingdom in North India, but there is no evidence of village assemblies being referred to during their reign.
 
 
 
• Chalukya dynasty:-
 
 
• It was known for its art and architecture, but there is no mention of village assemblies in their history either.
